name: a_profile_is_driven_by_its_vertices
why: BRIEF R5, 24/10/2026: every extrude_profile came back locked with FIXED relations, and the only dimension a variable could drive was the depth: the width of a rib, a slot, the inside of a clamp could not follow a name. With «dimensions» «driven» every vertex gets a horizontal and a vertical dimension from the origin, in the order of the vertices, x before y; a coordinate of zero gets a relation instead. The L has three vertices on the negative side and two on the Y axis, so the dimensions are D1..D10: (-30,10) D1 D2, (30,10) D3 D4, (30,20) D5 D6, (0,20) y D7, (0,50) y D8, (-30,50) D9 D10. Moving a vertex must give the volume of the shoelace formula for the moved vertex (computed by script: 15000, 15750, 16500, 18500 mm3), and the vertex at -30 driven to 40 must stay on its side.

expect.why: ten dimensions and two relations hold the six vertices
the vertex at x = -30 goes to -40: a dimension is a distance, the side stays
